module Main where

import Data.Array

solve :: Array (Int, Int) Char -> Int -> Int -> Int -> String
solve grid r c size =
    let first = grid ! (r, c)
        same = all (\(i, j) -> grid ! (i, j) == first)
                    [(i, j) | i <- [r .. r + size - 1],
                              j <- [c .. c + size - 1]]
    in if same
       then [first]
       else
           let half = size `div` 2
           in "("
              ++ solve grid r c half
              ++ solve grid r (c + half) half
              ++ solve grid (r + half) c half
              ++ solve grid (r + half) (c + half) half
              ++ ")"

main :: IO ()
main = do
    input <- getContents
    case words input of
        [] -> return ()
        (nStr : rest) ->
            let n = read nStr :: Int
                rows = take n rest
                grid = listArray ((0, 0), (n - 1, n - 1)) (concat rows)
            in putStrLn (solve grid 0 0 n)
